# `current_timezone`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the current session local timezone.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
current_timezone()
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 0 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- current_timezone, example 1
> SELECT current_timezone();
-- the result differs on every run
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.1.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
